name: LP-MSPM0G3519 LaunchPad development kit
sources: MSPM0Gx51x data sheet SLASFA2C (rev. September 2026, read 2026-10-07: features, memories, peripherals); LaunchPad user guide SLAU947 (October 2024, read 2026-10-07: kit contents, Table 2-1 jumpers J12 to J23, J101 isolation block, Figure 4-2 BoosterPack connectors, EnergyTrace on the XDS110); MSPM0 SDK 2.11.00.07 example READMEs (pins)

columns.head: The chip: MSPM0G3519
items: Processor: Arm Cortex-M0+
Runs the program, up to 80 million steps a second (80 MHz) with the PLL. No floating-point unit
Flash: 512 kB
Two banks, so one can hold an update while the other runs. Plus 16 kB of data flash
RAM: 128 kB
Working memory: 4 times the LP-MSPM0G3507 and 128 times the C1104
Power: 3.3 V on this board
The chip accepts 1.62 to 3.6 V, so 5 V parts need care

columns.head: Connections inside the chip
items: GPIO: up to 94 pins
Plain on/off pins. 80 header positions on the board
UART: 7 / I2C: 3 / SPI: 3
Serial text, sensor bus, fast display bus (one SPI to 32 Mbit/s)
CAN-FD: 2
The car and machine network. Needs a transceiver chip to reach a real bus
ADC: 2 / DAC: 1
Two 12-bit voltmeters at 4 million samples a second; one 12-bit voltage maker
Math accelerator
Hardware divide, square root and sine/cosine, since the core has no floating point
AES, random numbers, CRC
Hardware encryption with key storage, a true random-number source, checksums

columns.head: On the board, and missing
items: On the board
USB debug probe with EnergyTrace (it measures current), RGB LED, red LED, 3 buttons, 40 MHz and 32 kHz crystals
Headers
80 pins in eight rows (J1 to J8): room for two BoosterPacks, plus a QEI encoder header
Not on the chip
No floating point, no neural accelerator, no I2S audio, no USB for the chip, no radio
Watch out
J12 and J13 switch the serial pins between USB and the header. Our OpenOCD build does not list this chip
